title: Isandro and the Bakery
author: E. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Gideon Vasquez, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
